title: Flames move quick through designated areas at Devens RFTA
description: Under the watchful eyes of area firefighters, flames consumed the dry leaves, loose branches and grass on the western edge of Turner Drop Zone Oct. 27 during a prescribed burn at Devens Reserve Forces Training Area, Mass. The fire enriched about 115 acres while reducing fuel and preventing unplanned fires.
